verifier_summary: Several issues identified across experiments. In E02 (fibrotic liver), tumor cells (CE2) are incorrectly included as delivery recipients and the outcome merges hepatocyte and tumor cell transfection. In E04 (HCC), the LNP formulation name and description are both marked missing despite S05 explicitly stating 'mRNA lipid nanoparticles (LNPs)'. In E06 (secondary liver cancer xenograft), the attenuated protein expression outcome from S06 is omitted entirely, while E05 correctly captures it. E04 also includes hepatocytes as delivery recipients which may belong to the healthy/fibrotic/cirrhotic experiments rather than the HCC-specific experiment.
